name: cyberine-devguard
description: Session-scope guard for Claude Code: keep file writes inside the session's own repository, and keep git worktrees under .claude/worktrees/.

plugins.name: cyberine-devguard
plugins.description: PreToolUse hook that asks before Write, Edit, NotebookEdit, an obvious Bash write or a filesystem MCP write reaches another repository, or a Bash git worktree add lands outside .claude/worktrees/, plus status, explain and worktree report skills.

plugins.name: cyberine-worktree
plugins.description: WorktreeCreate hook: agent and EnterWorktree worktrees go to <main repository>/.claude/worktrees/<name> on branch worktree/<name>, based on the session's HEAD, with a session-start warning when another WorktreeCreate hook is configured. Optional; replaces Claude Code's own worktree creation while installed.
